issues.description: Entire compiled script content sent over RPC and held in memory just to enable download
issues.detail: backend/kale/rpc/nb.py reads the full script_path into memory and ships it through RPC alongside metadata. For large notebooks/pipelines this bloats the response and JupyterLab state. A dedicated download endpoint (or reading the file lazily from package_path) would avoid duplicating the artifact in the frontend store.

issues.description: open() without explicit encoding can fail or corrupt non-ASCII content
issues.detail: open(script_path) uses the platform default encoding. On systems where LANG is C/ASCII (common in containers), reading a script containing non-ASCII characters will raise UnicodeDecodeError and break compile_notebook. Use open(script_path, encoding='utf-8').

issues.description: Downloaded file is the intermediate .py script, not the compiled pipeline package
issues.detail: package_path (the actual compiled pipeline artifact, e.g. .tar.gz/.yaml from kfputils.compile_pipeline) is what users typically want. The diff downloads script_path (the pre-compile .kale.py source) but labels the UI 'Download compiled file' and falls back to 'pipeline.kale.py'. This mismatches the PR's stated intent.

issues.description: TypeScript prop compiledContent not declared on DeployProgress props
issues.detail: DeployProgress.tsx references props.compiledContent and DeploysProgress passes it down, but the diff doesn't show compiledContent added to DeployProgress's IProps interface. If the interface isn't updated in an unshown hunk, TS compilation will fail. Verify the prop type was added.

issues.description: Download icon lacks keyboard accessibility and button semantics
issues.detail: GetAppIcon is rendered with onClick directly on the SVG. It isn't focusable, has no role='button', and can't be triggered by keyboard. Wrap it in an IconButton (consistent with MUI usage elsewhere) so it's accessible and matches the surrounding link styling.

When compiledPath.split('/').pop() returns empty, fallback is 'pipeline.kale.py'. If the actual artifact is YAML/tarball, the .py extension misleads users. Derive the extension from the source path or omit a generic fallback.

review.summary: The feature works at a basic level but has structural and correctness concerns. The backend ships the entire script body over RPC without explicit UTF-8 encoding, and what's downloaded is the intermediate .kale.py source rather than the actual compiled pipeline artifact (package_path) — which contradicts the PR's stated intent of downloading the compiled pipeline file. On the frontend, the new compiledContent prop may be missing from DeployProgress's props interface, and the download trigger is an unfocusable SVG icon rather than a proper button. None are show-stoppers but should be addressed before merge.
